notes.title: Patch Notes April 9, 2025 – GnollHack Playtest
notes.notes:
[h2]Added Save File Tracking for Server Posted Games[/h2]
[list]
[*] Games played on Windows must be tracked by the GnollHack Account server in order to be eligible for server posting when the game is finished.
[*] Save File Tracking ensures that a saved game is loaded only once and it has not been modified after saving. This will prevent save scumming.
[*] Save File Tracking can be turned on in the settings and is a prerequisite for server posting.
[/list]
